subject: Vendr profile kickoff + evidence walkthrough request
messages:
From: Alicia Rome <alicia.rome@bluecrest.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@bluecrest.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — Vendr profile and SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this. We're starting procurement for a pilot integration with Redwood and need to complete Vendr profile onboarding and a quick evidence review for SOC 2 controls (security and availability).

Can you confirm:
- Who will be the profile owner for Vendr?
- Which SOC 2 artifacts you can share (summary + evidence stubs) for the controls mapped to network security and change management?
- If we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough next week to review artifacts and ask a few quick follow-up questions.

We typically request a short list of attachments (SOC 2 summary, sign-off matrix, and a sample firewall/config snapshot or the equivalent). If there are any platform constraints (e.g., on-prem evidence only), flag that up front.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Rome
Security Manager, BlueCrest Payments
Alicia.Rome@bluecrest.com


From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Rome <alicia.rome@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — Vendr profile and SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Alicia — thanks for the note and welcome. I own Vendr profile work for this cohort, so I'll be the profile owner.

Quick answers up front:
- Profile owner: Priya Natarajan (I'll be the point of contact during onboarding).
- Artifacts we can provide immediately: SOC 2 summary report (redacted), system architecture diagram, change management policy excerpt, and a sample access-control evidence excerpt.
- Platform constraints: none — we can upload to Vendr or share a short Drive folder (see link below). For sensitive artifacts we can provide redacted PDFs and presigned access via S3 if needed.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben and Marissa to attach the SOC 2 summary + the authz matrix CSV and confirm redaction status.
2) We schedule a 30-min walkthrough (I'll propose times below).
3) After the walkthrough we'll upload the approved artifacts to the Vendr portal and update the profile fields.

Proposed times (PDT): Tue 19 May 09:30-10:00, Tue 19 May 14:00-14:30, Wed 20 May 11:00-11:30. Which works best?

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xq-example-docs (temporary folder with redacted items)

Priya
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Alicia Rome <alicia.rome@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — Vendr profile and SOC 2 artifacts

Priya / Alicia — attaching the files we discussed. Short notes on each: 

Attachments: 
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (redacted; includes control mapping for security and availability)
- authz_matrix.csv (service accounts + role owners)
- config_sample.txt (sanitized network config snippet) — will only provide on S3 presign if BlueCrest needs the raw stanza.

Notes: 
- The SOC 2 report is redacted at the control evidence level; it contains the auditor's opinion and our control mapping.
- authz_matrix lists current owners for vaults, deployment CI, and prod access. It's exported from our internal IAM inventory and may include transient accounts we can trim before upload to Vendr.
- If Vendr asks for an evidence link instead of file upload, we prefer presigned S3 links (short TTL).

Scheduling: Tue 19 May 09:30 PDT works for me. I'll be on the call to walk through the authz matrix.

Ben
Ben Carter
Trust & Safety Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Rome <alicia.rome@bluecrest.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — Vendr profile and SOC 2 artifacts

Thanks all — confirmed for Tue 19 May 09:30 PDT. Agenda (15 min review, 10 min Q&A, 5 min next steps):
- Quick profile fields to confirm (contact, primary region, data residency flag)
- SOC 2 summary highlights and where the evidence lives (Drive vs Vendr upload vs presigned link)
- Ownership transfer for future evidence rotations (who to ping at Redwood)

Alicia — I'll take notes & create the Vendr ticket after the call. After we upload the artifacts we'll set a 90-day evidence rotation reminder and share the manifest.

Forwarded attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, authz_matrix.csv

Marissa Cole
Security Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
